title: Add JVM/Kotlin/Bazel pilot fixture plan
description: Close the current evidence gap: existing research covers Kotlin+Gradle and Java+Bazel, but the customer pilot asks for Kotlin+Bazel first. Design a portable fixture or customer-repo run path that proves stack inference, scoped module assessment, build/test command detection, and not_assessed behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Plan names the fixture source or customer-repo path; scope input uses SpecKit terms; expected evidence includes BUILD/BUILD.bazel, Kotlin source, command candidates, executed-or-not_assessed build/test status, and no Maven/Gradle inference when Bazel markers own the build.

title: Create harness and model pilot run-cards
description: Create evidence-focused run-cards for OpenCode and target harness families: Superpowers, gsd, gsd2, Oh My OpenAgent. Cover model slices MiniMax, Kimi, and GLM through OpenCode coding plan. The run-card must capture observations, not decide policy.
acceptance_criteria: Run-cards define exact prompt, expected artifacts, provenance fields, model/harness identity, command log expectations, unsupported-claim capture, JSON validation, and not_assessed behavior; OpenCode+MiniMax/Kimi/GLM is first-class; unverified harness capabilities stay TBD, not claimed.

title: Define process metric catalog without policy thresholds
description: Turn sdp_lab metrics and process hygiene ideas into a portable metric catalog for observations over time. Include flow, evidence quality, scope discipline, correctness signal, review signal, AI behavior, and stack/harness/model slices. Do not import traffic-light ratings as product truth.
acceptance_criteria: Each metric has name, unit, scope dimensions, collection method, evidence source, not_assessed rule, and privacy risk; thresholds are explicitly owned by sdp-gate or consuming policy; no metric is an opaque aggregate health score.

title: Design evidence event and provenance contract
description: Adapt the useful parts of sdp_lab evidence-envelope and ChangePassport evidence-event into a portable sdp-trace contract: source, external_ref, observed_at, collected_at, actor, event_type, status, artifact_uri/hash, evidence strength, and provenance chain. Remove PR-only and Beads-only assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Contract supports harness, CI, review, command, file, test, deployment, and manual evidence events; artifact references are inspectable; provenance records actor/model/harness/tool identity when available; missing model/tool data can be explicit not_assessed; examples are schema-valid.

title: Design time-series observation contract
description: Design the portable schema vocabulary for process observations over time: observation, metric_sample, metric_stream, trace_snapshot, process_signal, evidence_ref, provenance_ref, and not_assessed. The contract must support moving windows without requiring a fixed baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Design explains how current observations accumulate over time; examples show current window vs previous window without policy verdicts; every metric sample references evidence or is marked not_assessed; no opaque health score is introduced; schema evolution path is explicit.

title: Define sdp-trace / sdp-gate boundary contract
description: Update the product model so sdp-trace records observations, metric streams, evidence bundles, provenance, trace snapshots, and assessment inputs, while sdp-gate owns policy evaluation, gate decisions, process pass/fail, readiness, degradation verdicts, and overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Docs state that sdp-gate is built on sdp-trace and inherits its contracts; sdp-trace does not claim to decide degradation or gate readiness; existing gate-verdict/decision wording is either narrowed to recorded external verdict inputs or scheduled for schema replacement; no public text implies sdp-trace owns policy.

title: Extract portable ideas from sdp_lab
description: Produce a source-mapped extraction memo listing which sdp_lab ideas become sdp-trace contracts, which are rejected, and which belong in sdp-gate. Candidate sources include evidence-envelope, sdp-pr-gate evidence-event, process hygiene telemetry, sdp metrics, trace tail model, product layering, telemetry allowlist, and attestation predicate.
acceptance_criteria: Memo cites exact sdp_lab source files; every imported idea is mapped to SpecKit-aligned sdp-trace terms; every rejected idea names the coupling risk; Beads, Operator Mode, runtime phases, and policy thresholds are explicitly excluded from the portable contract.

title: Pilot: sdp-trace time-series evidence substrate
description: Shape sdp-trace into the portable evidence/provenance/time-series substrate that lets downstream policy engines such as sdp-gate answer whether AI-assisted delivery is improving, stable, degrading, or not assessable over time. Keep sdp-trace independent from sdp_lab, Beads, Operator Mode, and any harness runtime.
acceptance_criteria: SpecKit terms are used; sdp-trace owns evidence, provenance, observations, metric streams, trace snapshots, and not_assessed; sdp-gate owns policy, gate pass/fail, readiness, degradation decisions, and overrides; pilot artifacts cover OpenCode, Superpowers/GSD-style harnesses, MiniMax/Kimi/GLM, and JVM/Kotlin/Bazel evidence paths.

title: Reframe CTO and team docs around process movement
description: Rewrite public docs so the CTO question is framed correctly: sdp-trace records evidence-backed process movement over time; sdp-gate applies inherited contracts and policies to decide degradation/readiness. Avoid saying sdp-trace itself gates the process.
acceptance_criteria: README, CTO brief, team lead playbook, concepts, and evidence policy use observation/trend language; public docs explain that missing evidence produces not_assessed input; gate/pass/fail policy language is either moved to sdp-gate context or explicitly described as external recorded verdict input.

title: Update compatibility matrices only from evidence
description: Turn current TBD matrices into evidence-backed status artifacts after pilot runs. Rows for harness, model, and stack support must show what was observed, what artifact proves it, and what remains not_assessed.
acceptance_criteria: Harness/model/JVM matrices never claim support without a committed example or run artifact; OpenCode MiniMax/Kimi/GLM rows cite run-card outputs; Superpowers/gsd/gsd2/Oh My OpenAgent rows distinguish prompt/rules access, tool log access, hook support, and evidence export; unsupported or untested items remain not_assessed/TBD.

title: Build customer pilot evidence package outline
description: Design the customer-facing pilot package that demonstrates sdp-trace as the evidence/trend substrate: run cards, raw evidence artifacts, metric streams, trace snapshots, unsupported claims, not_assessed list, and the handoff surface consumed by sdp-gate.
acceptance_criteria: Package outline answers CTO question as data, not policy; includes OpenCode model slices, harness slices, JVM/Kotlin/Bazel slice, schema validation evidence, and an explicit section showing what sdp-gate would decide later but sdp-trace does not decide.

title: Add schema validation and fixture strategy
description: Define how sdp-trace validates JSON artifacts beyond jq syntax. Choose a validator strategy, define fixture layout, and ensure examples for evidence events, observation streams, trace snapshots, and assessment inputs are machine-checked.
acceptance_criteria: Validation command is documented; fixtures include pass and not_assessed cases; schema IDs are stable; validation excludes benchmark checkouts; no tool depends on sdp_lab runtime.
